text:
julio_finance: Heads-up — Aurora Health disputed INV-2026-02. They were billed $2,900 in burst/overage on Feb 6 and say the burst was caused by our degraded region during a failover.

tara_sales: Context: Aurora has a Dedicated commit (3xA100 equiv) $12,250/mo. They report retries and elevated latency from 09:40-12:05 UTC.

ian_csm: Support case CASE-14022: https://redwood.at/support/CASE-14022. Customer logs show failures 09:42-10:55 and slowed tails until ~12:05. They want the overage removed or an SLA credit. :frowning:

ops_mina: Infra corroborates an orchestrator leader flip at 09:41 that caused a slow cold-start cascade. Measured partial degradation window = 2.4h. Root cause and fix PR: https://github.com/redwood/orch/pull/6233.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-02: Reserved commit = $12,250; Burst/overage = $2,900; SLA credit applied = $0; Total = $15,150.

julio_finance: SLA: "Partial degradation >=2h and <4h -> 12% credit of monthly Dedicated fee." 12% of $12,250 = $1,470. Options: (A) apply SLA credit $1,470 only -> invoice = $13,680 (keep overage), (B) waive burst $2,900 + apply SLA credit $1,470 = total concession $4,370 -> invoice = $10,780. Waiving overage is a revenue write-off; SLA credit is contractual. Need RevOps OK for B.

lisa_revops: I can approve up to $5k one-off concessions if Ops provides RCA and agrees to corrective actions.

tara_sales: Customer explicitly asked to remove the overage; they're mid-deployment and want quick resolution. Suggest Option B + a 30-day complimentary burst buffer.

ops_mina: Ops accepts responsibility and will add RCA blurb to CASE-14022. Fix scheduled to roll this week. Recommend waiving the overage.

julio_finance: Requesting formal sign-off from @lisa_revops for Option B (waive overage + SLA credit). Will issue corrected invoice and credit memo once approved and update AR.

lisa_revops: Approved. Record: concession_type=one_time_writeoff; waived_overage=$2,900; sla_credit=$1,470; total_concession=$4,370. I'll tag in RevOps ledger for audit.

julio_finance: Thanks — creating credit memo CM-2026-045 and corrected invoice INV-2026-02-C. Draft customer note: "We've applied a $4,370 concession (includes SLA credit) and issued corrected invoice INV-2026-02-C. We're sorry for the disruption; ops has a fix and RCA is attached." Sending after docs posted.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-045 created. Corrected invoice INV-2026-02-C issued.

ian_csm: Sent to customer with a 30-day complimentary burst buffer offer. Customer replied: "Appreciate the quick handling and the buffer — thank you. Looking forward to RCA." :thumbsup:
